name: predict-output
title: Predict Output
description: Predict the output, compare your answer and read the explanation.
useCases: Before running an example, a student predicts its output and reads the explanation.
At a lesson checkpoint, an instructor supplies possible results for an expression. The app records the learner’s choice through onAnswer.
task: Predict the output, compare your answer and read the explanation.
behavior: answer should match an entry in options. onAnswer receives the selected answer and explanation describes the result.
